livingCost.basis: Single adult aged 25-50 in a medium-sized city, 2026, net need 16,850 kr/month. Konsumentverket 2026 (https://stpubshop.blob.core.windows.net/publikationer/kostnadsberakningar-hushallskostnader-2026-sv-kov_tga_32d.pdf): food cooked at home 2,730 + clothes/leisure/phone/hygiene 2,140 + one-person household costs 3,530 (consumables 200, home equipment 920, internet and mobile 1,000, other media 640, electricity 400, water 220, home insurance 150) = 8,400. Rent 7,450 (Konsumentverket's 2026 medium-city flat assumption, https://www.konsumentverket.se/ekonomi/flytta-eller-bo-hemma-kostnad/). Local transport about 1,000 (my estimate, no source retrieved). 8,400 + 7,450 + 1,000 = 16,850 net. Gross found with Skatteverket's 2026 tax table 32 (https://skatteverket.entryscape.net/rowstore/dataset/88320397-5c32-4c16-ae79-d36d95b17b95): 20,200 kr/month gross less 3,337 tax = 16,863 net, so 20,200 x 12 = 242,400 gross a year.

studentLoan.description: Both values are in percent. CSN studiemedel (public study support) has a grant and a loan part; for full-time study in 2026 it is 3,398 kr a week (grant 1,030 + loan 2,368), or 13,592 kr per 4-week payment. The loan accrues interest from the first payout; repayment starts at the earliest six months after study support ends, and always after a year-end. Real rate = 2.135 - 0.3 = about 1.8 percent on headline CPI (about 1.4 percent on CPIF 0.7). Sources: https://www.csn.se/bidrag-och-lan/studiemedel.html

schooling.primarySchool: Grundskola (compulsory comprehensive school) starts with förskoleklass (preschool class, the year a child turns 6) and årskurs 1-6 (lågstadiet and mellanstadiet), ages 7-12. From autumn 2028 it becomes a 10-year grundskola and 6-year-olds start årskurs 1 directly (Skolverket: https://www.skolverket.se/forandringar-inom-skolomradet/en-skola-i-forandring/tioarig-grundskola).
schooling.middleSchool: Högstadiet (lower secondary), årskurs 7-9, ages 13-15/16, ends compulsory school with the slutbetyg. To enter a gymnasium yrkesprogram you need pass grades (A-E) in Swedish, English, maths and five other subjects; for a högskoleförberedande program, passes in 12 subjects. In spring 2026, 83.5 percent of 9th graders were eligible (Skolverket press release 2026-09-24: https://www.skolverket.se/om-skolverket/nyheter-och-pressmeddelanden/pressmeddelanden/pressmeddelanden/2026-09-24-forsta-gangen-storre-andel-pojkar-an-flickor-ar-behoriga-till-gymnasieskolan).
schooling.schoolLeaving: Gymnasieskola (upper secondary), 3 years, ages 16-19, with 18 national programmes: 6 högskoleförberedande (Ekonomi-, Estetiska, Humanistiska, Naturvetenskaps-, Samhällsvetenskaps-, Teknikprogrammet) and 12 yrkesprogram. Ends in a gymnasieexamen (SeQF level 4) with slutbetyg; from autumn 2025 new students study 'ämnen' with subject grades (Gy25: https://www.skolverket.se/forandringar-inom-skolomradet/en-skola-i-forandring/gy25----amnesbetyg-pa-gymnasial-niva). University entry uses the grade-based jämförelsetal and/or the optional Högskoleprovet (0.00-2.00; at least one third of places are allocated on it, UHR: https://www.uhr.se/studier-och-antagning/tilltrade-till-hogskolan/Urval-till-grundniva/Urval-med-hogskoleprov/).
schooling.vocational: Yrkesprogram in gymnasieskolan (e.g. El- och energiprogrammet, Bygg- och anläggningsprogrammet, Vård- och omsorgsprogrammet, Fordons- och transportprogrammet), then optionally Yrkeshögskola (YH): programmes are usually 1-2 years (200-400 YH points), with yrkeshögskoleexamen (SeQF level 5) or kvalificerad yrkeshögskoleexamen (level 6), at least a quarter spent on LIA (learning at work), mostly free and CSN-eligible (https://www.yrkeshogskolan.se/langd-poang-och-examen). Adults can use komvux (municipal adult education) and folkhögskola.
schooling.tierCommunity: Yrkeshögskola (YH) programmes plus folkhögskola and komvux: 1-2 year vocational or bridging study, free, CSN-eligible.
schooling.tierState: Regional universities and högskolor such as Örebro universitet, Karlstads universitet, Högskolan i Borås, Umeå universitet: kandidatexamen (180 hp, 3 years), master (1-2 years), most professional degrees 3-5.5 years; free for Swedish/EU students.
schooling.tierElite: The most selective institutions: Karolinska institutet (medicine), KTH and Chalmers (engineering), Lunds universitet, Uppsala universitet, Handelshögskolan i Stockholm. Same zero fees for Swedish/EU students; selection is by grades and Högskoleprovet, not price.
schooling.gradeSystem: Six-step scale A, B, C, D, E, F: higher is better, A-E are passes, E is the lowest pass and F is a fail; a dash means no grade (Skolverket). Criteria are written at E, C and A; B and D sit between. Grades are set from årskurs 6. In grundskolan the merit value (meritvärde) is the sum of grade points A=20, B=17.5, C=15, D=12.5, E=10, F=0 over 17 subjects (max 340); the national average for spring 2026 was 230.9 of 340, about 13.6 per subject, between D and C (Skolverket). The grade-point values and the 16-subject/320 variant come from background knowledge, but the 340 maximum is confirmed by Skolverket and the 20-point top by UHR (merit value 19 or more on the Swedish scale earns the maximum 2.5 merit-point compensation). Gymnasium leaving grades are credit-weighted averages on the same 0-20 scale (jämförelsetal, max 20.00, plus up to 2.5 merit points); a pass (E or better) in courses/subjects totalling 2,250 of 2,500 credits is normally needed for gymnasieexamen (background knowledge, not fetched). Reform: a 10-step scale (1-10) with no pass mark and centrally marked national final tests is planned from autumn 2028, first new merit values for school leavers in 2031 (Skolverket: https://www.skolverket.se/forandringar-inom-skolomradet/en-skola-i-forandring/nytt-betygssystem).
schooling.startingAges: Förskoleklass at 6 (compulsory, the year a child turns 6), årskurs 1 at 7, årskurs 9 ends at 15-16, so compulsory schooling is ages 6/7-16. No track split before gymnasium: at 16 students choose a högskoleförberedande program or a yrkesprogram (3 years to age 19). Higher education from 19+: bachelor 3 years (kandidatexamen 180 hp), master 1-2 years, degrees like nurse 3 years (180 hp), teacher, engineer and doctor longer (studera.nu: https://www.studera.nu/att-valja-utbildning/vagar/utbildningsnivaer-och-examina/).

highlights: Sweden has no legal minimum wage; union agreements set the floor, e.g. 26,626 kr a month in retail from April 2026 (about $2,670).
University is free for Swedish citizens, and 2026 full-time study support is 3,398 kr a week (1,030 grant, 2,368 loan at 2.135% interest).
caveats:
The session's WebSearch budget ran out partway through the task, so later figures came straight from official APIs and pages (SCB PxWeb API, Medlingsinstitutet xlsx, Skatteverket open tax tables, Riksbank, World Bank) rather than from search.

All pay figures are SCB 2025 full-time-equivalent monthly pay x 12, which does not include the 2026 collective-agreement raises (probably +2 to 3 percent), and SCB monthly pay is not the same as total annual cash pay (holiday supplement, year-end bonuses).

Medians are used where SCB publishes them. Where only age-group means exist (mechanical engineer mid-career, lawyer early-career, software mid-level) I scaled the mean by the occupation's all-ages median/mean ratio; software junior is a midpoint estimate (low confidence).

LOW-CONFIDENCE: ceoLargeCompany (12,000,000 kr is an unverified estimate; no source found), the airline first officer and captain figures (SCB 'Piloter m.fl.' with small samples, about 260 to 340 employees per age group, includes non-airline pilots), and the local-transport line (about 1,000 kr a month) in livingCost. Pharmacist (apotekare) mean and median are suppressed by SCB, so it is estimated from the public-sector median and the all-sector quartiles.

Minimum wage: Sweden has none by law, so I used the Svensk Handel and Handels retail agreement floor for age 18 (from 2026-04-01). Other floors are lower (Kommunal/SKR 23,638; Visita age 18 19,992) or higher (Byggavtalet skilled 35,322), so the representative figure is a judgement call. The 26,626 kr is the lowest retail tier at age 18, and adults with a year of retail experience get 27,530 kr.

Student-loan rates are given in percent (2.135 and 0.3), not fractions. I used headline CPI (0.3 percent, August 2026) as inflation; CPIF was 0.7 percent.

The grade-point values (A=20 ... E=10), the 16-subject/320 variant, the 2,250-of-2,500-credit rule for gymnasieexamen and the fact that grades start in årskurs 6 come from background knowledge and were not confirmed on a fetched page; the 340 maximum, the 230.9 average, the A-F scale, the 2028 reform and the merit-point cap are sourced. No typical jämförelsetal for gymnasium leavers was found. The elite-tier tuition entries rely on the national rule (studera.nu), not each university's own fee page. Table 32 of Skatteverket's 2026 tax tables was assumed to match the roughly 32 percent average municipal plus regional tax rate without checking the table-to-rate mapping.
